text: Agnieszka's daughter Zofia has her grade 5 piano exam on 2 November 2026, morning slot. Agnieszka says she's practising every night but properly nervous. Text Zofia good luck the night before.
graham - season ticket at villa park again, been going since 1987. hates the new kit lol
Freya called. Her dad's knee op is Thursday at 8am, she's driving him in and staying over at his. Ring her Friday afternoon to see how it went.
Patrick and his wife Mariam are off to Lisbon for their 10th anniversary, flying out the 14th at some ungodly hour. He's planned the whole thing in secret, she thinks it's a weekend in Bath.
xavier into warhammer big time now, painting a whole ultramarines army. said he'd show me the dreadnought next time
Okay so Connor's leaving do is the 30th, half 6 at the Crown. Kofi's organising. I said I'd chip in for the card and the gift, need to send Kofi a tenner by Friday.
Vikram got the job!! Starts at the hospital trust in January. Send congrats.
Neha's brother Lwazi... no wait, Lwazi is her cousin. Cousin Lwazi is moving to Manchester end of the month for uni. She's lending him her old car.

Lunch with Francesca. She's been struggling since the breakup with Alfie in the summer, not sleeping, and her mum's not well either. She's thinking of moving back to Bristol to be nearer her mum, maybe in the spring. Should take her out for a proper dinner next week, my treat. Maybe Thursday, she finishes early.
Divya - vegan, also can't do mushrooms. For the 9th.

Caitlin's book club picked the new Sally Rooney for November. She reads about three books a week, mostly crime and anything set in Ireland. She's also started writing her own detective novel, two chapters in, won't let anyone read it. Birthday is 22 March so a Waterstones voucher would be a safe bet.
Note to self: car MOT Tuesday at 9, drop keys in the night before. Also bins.
Lin's cat Biscuit had to have two teeth out yesterday, poor thing's on soft food. Lin was in bits about it. Check in with her tomorrow evening.
Elena and Anika moving in together! Viewing a flat in Clapton on Saturday at 11 and another one Sunday. Anika's already measuring for a sofa.
Ayo said the 5 a side final is next Wednesday 7pm, they're playing the team that beat them 6-0 in September. He's captain now. Go and watch if I can.

so Sean rang, um, his mum Ciara is turning seventy on the fourth of December and they're doing a surprise lunch at the golf club, twelve thirty, and he wants me to bring the old photos from Cork. I need to dig those out of the loft this weekend.
Alice's knitting obsession has reached jumper stage. Third one this year, all Fair Isle. Wants a proper yarn winder apparently, mentioned it twice.
Jack's dissertation hand in was today, he's knackered but relieved. Results not till June 2027.
Rachel cancelled the hen do in Benidorm, the wedding's been pushed back. She sounded gutted. Don't bring it up at work.
Stefan - Bayern fan, Polish mum, German dad. Knows everything about the 2001 Champions League final. Lives in Leyton with his partner Catalina and their dog Pretzel.
Joseph's retiring end of March 2027 after 31 years at the council. Do summat for it. Ask Eamon if the team's doing a collection.
Eamon's daughter starts nursery Monday morning. He's more nervous than she is.
call mum re sunday lunch
Graham's wife had a fall last week, broke her wrist. He's doing all the cooking now, which he says is going badly. Drop a lasagne round Wednesday after work.

Mariam's started a pottery course on Tuesday evenings, wants to make a full dinner set by summer. Her first bowl was apparently 'structurally ambitious'. She and Patrick are hosting a games night on the 8th, 7ish, bring something. Patrick's been learning Catan strategy off YouTube which is worrying.
Freya's sister Jess is expecting! Due in April. Freya's going to be an auntie for the first time and can't stop talking about it.
Kofi asked if I can help him move Saturday morning, 9am, van booked till 2. I said yes. Remind him to label the boxes this time.
Agnieszka - runs a sourdough stall at the Saturday market, Herne Hill. Allergic to nuts. Kids Zofia and Tomek.
Spoke to Neha about the climbing comp. It's 15 November in Sheffield, she's competing in the bouldering bit for the first time and is terrified. Send her a good luck message the morning of.
Patrick lost his grandad on Sunday. Funeral's probably next week, he'll let me know. Send a card to the house.
Vikram and his brother are doing the Three Peaks challenge in May 2027 for the hospice that looked after their dad. Sponsor them when the page goes up.
divya interview wed 2pm at deloitte, 2nd round. she's fine abt it. ask how it went thurs
Zofia's into Taylor Swift in a serious way. Got tickets for Wembley in June 2027 with her mum, already planning outfits. Agnieszka's dreading it.
Haircut moved to Friday at 4.15. Pick up dry cleaning on the way back.

Long chat with Connor tonight. He's been off work with his back for three weeks now, physio twice a week, says it's getting better slowly but he's going stir crazy at home. His girlfriend Elena has been brilliant apparently, doing everything. He's booked in for a scan on the 28th at 10 in the morning. I said I'd pop round Sunday with the PlayStation and FIFA. Should also ask if he wants a lift to the scan.
Lwazi plays bass in a covers band called the Late Fees. Gig at the Old Bell on the 1st, doors 8pm. Lol at the name.
francesca's birthday - 3 jan. likes gin, candles, anything with a fox on it
Caitlin and her husband Joseph Hughes just got back from Japan. Ten days, mostly Kyoto. She's obsessed with matcha now. Ask to see the photos when we meet on the 5th.
Jack says his dad's being made redundant in December. Family's a bit shaken. Jack's trying to stay positive. Keep an eye on him.
Ciara's grandson Alfie got into the county under 14s rugby squad! First match is the 18th, Saturday morning.

Stefan rang, Catalina's mum is visiting from Bogotá for three weeks from the 10th. He's nervous about the language thing, been doing Duolingo every day since August. Bless him. Catalina says her mum mostly wants to see Buckingham Palace and eat fish and chips, so it should be fine. I said we'd have them all round for Sunday dinner one weekend.
Rachel mentioned Elena might be up for joining the choir. Rehearsals Mondays 7.30. Must message Elena about it before the 3rd.
Ayo's new puppy, a cockapoo called Waffle. Collecting her on the 23rd. He's bought half of Pets at Home already.
Anika's PhD viva is Friday 13th November at 10am, of all dates. She's surprisingly calm. Text her Friday night to see how it went, and maybe flowers if she passes.

Dinner at Sean and Ciara's last night. Sean's doing the London Marathon in April 2027, training for it already, 40 miles a week. Ciara's knee replacement is booked for January so she can't go and watch. Their eldest is home from uni for reading week too.
Got to book the train to Leeds for Xavier's 40th. Party's Saturday 21st at 8, the Brewery Tap. Need to sort a present too, he's been on about a new set of dice for D&D.
alice + rachel both coming to mine fri 7pm. alice gluten free
Lin's off to Shanghai for Christmas to see her grandparents, first time since 2019. Flying the 19th, back 4 January. She's buzzing.
Grahams son Patrick (other Patrick lol) got engaged in Rome last weekend. Graham was beaming. Send a card.
Eamon is a massive vinyl nerd, mostly 70s soul and Northern soul. Goes to the record fair in Spitalfields first Sunday of every month. Worth remembering for Christmas.
Jess's housewarming got called off, the boiler packed in. She'll redo it in the new year.
Message from Kofi: his sister Mariam passed her driving test today, fourth attempt! He wants us all to take her for drinks Saturday evening.
Freya — new job at the BBC, digital team, started last Monday. Loving it so far but the commute from Croydon is brutal.

Note re Zofia: Agnieszka says she's been really down since the move to the new school, not settling, friendship stuff. Agnieszka's worried sick. Parents evening is Thursday the 12th at half 5. Ring Agnieszka after that to see what the teachers said.

Ok voice note. Neha's mum Divya, sorry, Neha's mum Mrs Kowalski, no, she's Mrs Reyes now, remarried, anyway her sixtieth is March 2027 and Neha wants to do a family trip to Kerala for it. She asked if I'd help find flights. Do that next week.
Vikram rang about the Arsenal tickets, he's got a spare for the 29th, 5.30 kick off. Said yes obviously.
Ciara's dog Murphy went missing yesterday afternoon, turned up this morning in a neighbour's shed. Ciara still shaken.
Graham Lewis - neighbour at 14, keeps bees, gave us honey in August. Nice to bring him something back from holiday.
Catch up w/ Joseph re the allotment. His tomatoes won a rosette at the village show in Sept. Wants to grow chillies next year. Promised to send him the seed link tonight.

Long call with Caitlin, Francesca and Connor about Elena's surprise 30th. It's on 7 February 2027, Saturday, at the cocktail place in Shoreditch, 8pm. Caitlin's doing the booking, Francesca's handling her boyfriend so he doesn't let it slip, Connor's doing the playlist. I'm on decorations apparently. She loves anything 80s so maybe go full 80s theme. We said a group present, she's been eyeing up a Polaroid camera. Don't forget to transfer Caitlin £25 by the end of the month.
